properties.description: pi-stacked pre-reaction complex of s-cis cyclopentadiene and maleic anhydride in the endo orientation (anhydride ring tucked under the diene's internal pi system)
properties.note: lowest verified minimum of this complex (54 modes, 0 imaginary); the reverse IRC outer frame of irc2_endo_channel.log relaxes to a shallow first-order saddle 0.0056 kcal/mol above it (irc2endo_A.opt.log / rc_endo_ch_end_opt.log, one -14.8 cm-1 intermolecular libration), while rcA_p.log/rcA_m.log (frame displaced 0.2 along that libration) relax to this same minimum. Barrier reference = this minimum.

file naming is historical: the endo saddle is stored in ts_exo_opt.log and in the ts_0002 run; one imaginary mode -416.39 cm-1 dominated by the forming pairs 2-11 and 4-12; carbonyl C 2.90 A from C1/C5, 3.76 A from C3 (secondary orbital overlap)

properties.description: endo-norbornene-5,6-dicarboxylic anhydride; anhydride tucked under the residual C=C (C=O 3.02-3.06 A from the C1=C5 midpoint, 3.71-3.73 A from the C7 methylene)
properties.note: kinetic product; 0.31 kcal/mol less stable than the exo adduct
properties.smiles_source: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES (canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True, H suppressed) perceived from the optimised geometry p_endo_ch_end_opt.log and, independently, from its IRC forward outer frame optimisation irc2endo_B.opt.log (identical string); InChIKey KNDQHSIWLOJIGP-UMRXKNAASA-N and the de-mapping round trip MolFromSmiles(this string) -> same key were verified; anhydride under the residual C1=C5. The endo/exo assignment is made from the geometry criterion (carbonyls 3.02 A from the C1=C5 midpoint vs 3.71 A from the CH2) and this key, not from atom-number stereodescriptor differences, which are symmetry-ambiguous in this Cs molecule.

properties.description: pi-stacked pre-reaction complex with the anhydride ring turned towards the C3 methylene bridge (exo orientation)
properties.note: clean minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies, lowest real mode 38.9 cm-1

file naming is historical: the exo saddle is stored in ts_endo_opt.log and in the ts_0001 run; one imaginary mode -410.13 cm-1 dominated by the forming pairs 2-11 and 4-12; carbonyl C 3.88-4.27 A from C1/C5, 3.05 A from C3 (no secondary orbital overlap)

properties.description: exo-norbornene-5,6-dicarboxylic anhydride; anhydride syn to the C7 methylene bridge (C=O 3.97-3.98 A from the C1=C5 midpoint, 2.98-3.03 A from the C7 methylene)
properties.note: thermodynamic product; 0.31 kcal/mol more stable than the endo adduct
properties.smiles_source: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES perceived from p_exo_ch_end_opt.log and irc2exo_B.opt.log (identical string); InChIKey KNDQHSIWLOJIGP-RNGGSSJXSA-N and the de-mapping round trip MolFromSmiles(this string) -> same key were verified; anhydride syn to the C7 methylene (3.97 A from the C1=C5 midpoint, 2.98 A from the CH2). Atom-number stereodescriptor comparisons are not used: the bridgeheads and the anhydride-fusion carbons are exchanged by the molecular mirror plane.

edges.barrier_note: dE = E(TSendo) - E(RCendo,min) = -572.998610236 - (-573.016646164) Eh = 0.018035928 Eh = 11.32 kcal/mol (electronic, no ZPE); referenced to the lowest verified complex minimum. Against the IRC-reached shallow saddle (-573.016637296 Eh) the same barrier is 11.31 kcal/mol.
edges.bond_changes_note: break = bonds whose order decreases (C1=C2, C4=C5, C11=C12); form = new sigma bonds C2-C11 and C4-C12 plus the C1-C5 bond whose order increases from single (diene) to double (adduct), verified as C1=C5 1.34 A in both optimised adducts
